tests.name: D3Q19 isotropy, opposite links and equilibrium moments
Headwind, crosswind, following wind and SI scaling
Uniform moving flow + matching moving road remains uniform
Symmetric stationary rider in still air has zero net force
Independent identical group/reference states give equal forces
Condition changes preserve time and fluid state; convergence is invalidated
Ground speed does not wrongly include ambient wind
Stable force history alone cannot pass the flow-through requirement
Numerical failure preserves the committed field and step count
